post_mortem_patterns.name: The Technical Debt Trap
post_mortem_patterns.summary: Startups that over-engineered their MVP for months only to find the core assumption was wrong.
post_mortem_patterns.key_lesson: Built to scale before building to sell. Technical simplicity in the early days is a feature, not a bug.

post_mortem_patterns.name: The Echo Chamber
post_mortem_patterns.summary: Founders who only interviewed friends and family, resulting in false positive validation.
post_mortem_patterns.key_lesson: Validation requires critical feedback from cold leads who have no social obligation to be polite.

post_mortem_patterns.name: Scaling on Sub-zero Unit Economics
post_mortem_patterns.summary: Startups that used heavy discounting or subsidized growth without a clear path to profitability.
post_mortem_patterns.key_lesson: If you lose money on every transaction, you can't make it up in volume.

post_mortem_patterns.name: Solving a Symptom, Not a Cause
post_mortem_patterns.summary: Products that addressed the visible irritation rather than the underlying structural problem.
post_mortem_patterns.key_lesson: Dig deeper. If users aren't willing to pay to fix the 'symptom', it's not a burning problem.
